description: How much rain fell: observed precipitation totals at a location. Use for "did it rain", "how much rain fell", "rain in the last 24 hours / since yesterday". Source: MRMS MultiSensor QPE Pass2 (radar bias-corrected to rain gauges) over 1/3/6/24/48/72 h windows (CONUS; 1 h only in Alaska and Hawaii). Values have about 2 mm (0.08 in) resolution, so 0 means under about 1 mm; data runs about an hour behind real time. Pass `at` (within 33 h) for totals ending at a past time (newest frame up to 3 h before it). With include_nowcast (default) it also returns a next-hour radar nowcast (CONUS): peak intensity (light/moderate/heavy), type and start time, not an amount. Forecast totals past the next hour: get_data (catalog); station reports: get_observations (observed).

at.description: RFC3339 end time within the last 33 h. Default: latest.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

location.description: Free-text place: "City, ST" (e.g. "Portland, OR"), US ZIP, venue/address where enabled, or "lat,lon". Use this OR lat+lon, not both.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

units.description: Units of every value in and out: imperial (default; °F, mph, in) or metric (°C, km/h, mm). si is deprecated and will be removed; use metric.

windows.description: Accumulation windows ending at the latest frame (or at `at`).

name: get_observed_precipitation

_sources.description: Per-source provenance: what produced these values and when.

title: Observed precipitation
